title: Qammar Abbasi- VS -FOP etc.
text:
Form No: HCJD/C-121 
ORDER SHEET. 
IN THE ISLAMABAD HIGH COURT, ISLAMABAD. 
JUDICIAL DEPARTMENT. 
 
 
 
Writ Petition. No.5669 of 2025 
 
Qammar Abbasi 
VS 
The Federation of Pakistan, etc 
S. No. of order/ 
proceedings 
Date of  order/ 
Proceedings 
Order with signature of Judge and that of parties or 
counsel where necessary.  
 
01.01.2026
Mr. Muhammad Saeed Khan Niazi, Advocate for the 
petitioner.  
 
 
 
At the very outset, learned counsel for the 
petitioner states that the petitioner will not press the 
instant petition and would be satisfied, if the 
respondent No.2 is directed to decide the pending 
application dated 28.11.2025, of the petitioner 
preferably within a period of two (02) days, as the 
petitioner’s visa is going to be expired on 04.01.2026.   
 
 
2. 
Keeping in view the urgency as pointed out by 
learned counsel for the petitioner, the instant petition 
is disposed of with the direction to respondent No.2 
/ 
Director 
General 
Immigration 
and 
Passport, 
Islamabad 
to 
decide 
the 
petitioner’s 
pending 
application strictly in accordance with law within a 
period of two (02) days from the date of this order.  
 
 
 
          (MUHAMMAD ASIF)      
                     JUDGE 
                        
 
 
Ahmed Sheikh 
Copy Dasti
subject: Miscelleneous, Other
remarks: Seeks unblocking of petitioner's passport. Petitioner visa is expiring on 04.01.2026
